registry.toolPdfDesc: Merge PDFs, split by range, extract or delete pages, rotate pages

demo.revealSource: This is the file the AI just handed over
demo.revealPanel: Here you can see its page count and size

pdf.mergeHint: Drag rows or use the arrows to reorder
pdf.mergeEmptyHint: Pick one or more files; pages are joined from top to bottom. Encrypted PDFs can't be processed and are flagged here.
pdf.pickEmptyHint: Files are processed in local memory and never uploaded.
pdf.rotateHint: Rotation applies to selected pages and is written on save
pdf.splitEmptyHint: The range is outside the document; check it and try again.
pdf.saveRemove: Save PDF without the selected pages
pdf.pickSplitDir: Choose a folder for the split files
pdf.errEncrypted: This PDF is encrypted (password or permission protected) and can't be processed
pdf.errInvalid: Not a valid PDF file, or the file is corrupted
pdf.errEmptyResult: The result would be empty; at least one page must remain
pdf.errDecryptPassword: This PDF needs a password to open
pdf.errDecryptWrongPassword: Wrong password, or the file is corrupted
pdf.errDecryptFailed: Could not remove the encryption from this PDF
pdf.errDecryptUnavailable: Failed to load the decryption component; check your network and retry
pdf.unlockHint: Enter the open password to continue (permission-encrypted files are unlocked automatically)
pdf.warnRangeClamped: Some pages are outside the document and were clipped: {tokens}

agent.toolPdfMerge: Merge multiple PDFs into one file
agent.toolPdfExtractPages: Extract selected PDF pages into a new file
agent.toolPdfSplit: Split a PDF into multiple files by page groups
